summary: Iteration 3 (Dashboard) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passes including new delay_days assertions. Frontend: dashboard route, KPI row, FilterRail, ShipmentTable, FilterPresets (save/apply/delete + localStorage persistence), last-used filter persistence, sorting, row-click navigation and sidebar nav all work. Two minor issues found (Delay section collapsed by default, page-size lacks a value <7 to demo pagination).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires Delay section open by default, but code uses defaultOpen={false}. filter-delay-* radios are hidden until user clicks the Delay header. All other audience/status/mode sections are correctly open by default.

page-size dropdown only offers [10, 25, 50, 100]. Since dataset has only 7 rows, pagination cannot actually be exercised by users. Spec hint suggests a smaller option (e.g. 5) so page-prev/page-next become enabled. Selecting page-size=10 keeps single page (rows=7).

action_items: FilterRail.jsx: change Delay <Section defaultOpen={false}> to defaultOpen={true} so Delay section is open by default per spec.
ShipmentTable.jsx: add a smaller option (e.g. 5) to the page-size <select> so pagination can be demonstrated with the current 7-row mock dataset, OR seed more shipments.
(Optional) Existing test_shipments.py::TestGetOrder::test_order_7821_five_legs was stale (data was simplified to 4 legs). Updated test to match current data (4 legs road, ocean, road, road).

(Optional) Verify intended UX: Sidebar 'Dashboard' nav now points to /dashboard (correct), but other nav items (All Shipments, In Transit, etc.) still point to /#workspace. May want to align them with the new Dashboard route filters.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is clean and well-structured (~150 lines); filtering/KPI logic uses useMemo properly.
preferences.js correctly uses safeParse and namespaced keys (uniroute.dashboard.presets.v1, uniroute.dashboard.last.v1). Good versioning.
Backend Shipment model now defines delay_days: int = 0 — correct default; only SHP-2025-4209 overrides to 12. Validated.
FilterRail Delay section defaultOpen={false} contradicts the iteration spec (open by default).
ShipmentTable page-size options [10,25,50,100] don't exercise pagination on a 7-row dataset; consider adding 5 or seeding more data.
Sidebar.jsx active-state logic uses loc.search comparison which doesn't highlight Dashboard correctly when on /dashboard (no search string). Minor UX nit.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_shipments.py (added TestDelayDays class with 3 tests; fixed stale test_order_7821 expecting 5 legs to match current 4-leg data)
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None. Dataset is hard-coded mock in backend/server.py (7 shipments).

Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://journey-view-1.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_shipments.py. Frontend dashboard at /dashboard. localStorage keys: 'uniroute.dashboard.presets.v1' and 'uniroute.dashboard.last.v1' - clear them between independent runs. Filter rail Delay section is currently collapsed by default (bug per spec).
rca_of_the_issue: Delay section default-open: in /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard/FilterRail.jsx line 132, the Delay <Section> is created with defaultOpen={false}. The Section component initializes its open state from this prop (useState(defaultOpen)), so children incl. filter-delay-{0|1|7|14} are not rendered until user clicks the header. Fix: change defaultOpen={false} to defaultOpen={true} (or remove the prop, since the Section default is true). For pagination: page-size <select> options array in ShipmentTable.jsx line 187 is [10,25,50,100]; add 5 to enable multi-page test on the 7-row dataset.
